sources_considered.why: Reports NewsGuard tracker counts from May 2023 through February 2024.
Documents a new kind of AI misinformation incident days before the post.
The current page shows only the 2026 count, not early-2024 figures.
Confirms the May 2023 count of 49 to 125, but its text has line breaks that make exact quoting unreliable.

receipt.public_excerpt: a rise in AI-generated sites making false or unverified claims from just under 50 in May to around 600 in December 2023, a more than tenfold increase across just over half a year.

evidence_items.explanation: A more than tenfold rise in AI content-farm sites in about seven months is fast growth in AI information pollution.

receipt.public_excerpt: The number of websites using AI-generated content to spread fake news has increased to 713 as of February 22

evidence_items.explanation: The count was still climbing in February 2024, about six weeks before the post.

evidence_items.locator: section 'The danger of X depending on AI', near end

receipt.public_excerpt: the first time X took Grok's misinformation, packaged it as a real trending news story, and promoted it to its entire user base

evidence_items.explanation: A new, platform-wide channel for AI-made false news appeared two days before the post, a further sign that the problem was escalating.

unresolved_gaps: NewsGuard's counts partly reflect how hard it searched, not only how many sites existed; no independent check of the totals was found.
There is no measure of how much these sites or incidents were actually read or believed.
